AFWD.justification: the electron pair moves toward the electrophilic center to form a new bond

AREV.justification: the displacement of the auxiliary group occurs in the opposite direction of the bond formation

CLINK.justification: the sequential addition of units creates a linear chain through repeated condensation

ENGAGR.justification: the molecule exists in a superposition of bonded and non-bonded states during the reaction peak

EVALF.justification: the chain reacts with a different molecule resulting in a failed cyclization

EVALT.justification: the chain ends find each other in space allowing for successful ring closure

FFUSE.justification: the two ends of the linear chain meet at the bridgehead to reconstitute the monomeric origin as a ring

FSPLIT.justification: the single monomer unit provides two distinct reactive sites for divergent chemical paths

IFIX.justification: the final covalent bond creates an irreversible structural fixation that prevents reopening

IMSCRIB.justification: the internal structural integrity of the monomer remains unchanged during the reaction

TANCH.justification: the final ring structure defines the physical and functional boundary of the completed molecule

VINIT.justification: the raw chemical feedstock exists as an undifferentiated potential before synthesis begins
